title: Trinidad and Tobago Government Tenders Scraper (ProcureTT)

noticeType.title: Notice type
noticeType.description: Which ProcureTT register to pull from.
enumTitles: ASPPA (Annual Schedule of Planned Procurement Activities)

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to fetch. Register sizes vary: roughly 400 tenders, 290 awards, 150 ASPPA entries, 40 pre-qualification notices, 10 disposals at last check.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Column to sort by. Leave blank to use the register's own default order. Valid options differ by notice type -- an invalid combination raises an error listing which options apply.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Only applies when 'Sort by' is set.

fetchDetail.title: Fetch detail page (tenders, pre-qualification, disposals only)
fetchDetail.description: For each record, additionally fetch its public per-entry detail page for richer fields (e.g. tenders gain Notice Type, Date of Issuance, precise Lines of Business codes, and Submission Deadline Time). One extra request per record -- slower for large runs. Ignored (with a log warning) for 'awards' and 'asppa', which have no separate detail page upstream.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages (or detail-page lookups) to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
